# plugreports

> Harm-reduction library of street drug profiles, busts, hotlines and verified help. USA, Canada, Europe, Australia, Africa.

Complete machine-readable drug records: [llms-full.txt](https://plugreports.com/llms-full.txt)

## Key pages
- [/hotlines/](https://plugreports.com/hotlines/) Verified overdose & crisis hotlines, 9 regions
- [/drugs/](https://plugreports.com/drugs/) A-Z index of all 430 substance profiles
- [/categories/](https://plugreports.com/categories/) Browse by category
- [/news/](https://plugreports.com/news/) Drug news & alerts
- [/busts/](https://plugreports.com/busts/) Busts & seizures tracker
- [/topics/](https://plugreports.com/topics/) Guides & explainers
- [/quit/](https://plugreports.com/quit/) Quitting, day by day
- [/sentencing/](https://plugreports.com/sentencing/) Drug sentencing by region
- [/pharmacies/](https://plugreports.com/pharmacies/) Verified online pharmacies
- [/rehabs/](https://plugreports.com/rehabs/) Verified rehab centers
- [/about/](https://plugreports.com/about/) Mission & editorial policy
